title: Polynomial algebra model for a prepared special chart
statement: Let R and Cbar be commutative rings, pi in R, and compatible algebra structures from R and R/(pi^2) to Cbar. Let d be prepared polynomial data [lem-weil-pbc-popescu-lift-preparation], including epsilon, f_l, a_k, E_k, h_klj, g_kl and the explicit lifting quotient D. Set C0=Cbar/(pi Cbar) and D0=D/(pi D). Let c:Cbar to D0 be an R-algebra map sending epsilon(X_i) to the original generator x_i of D0, and cmod:C0 to D0 a ring map whose composite with Cbar to C0 is c. For any chart k put a0 equal to the image of epsilon(reduced(a_k)) in C0, and t=c(epsilon(reduced(a_k))). Then the polynomial algebra C0[1/a0][z_j : j in E_k] is isomorphic as a C0-algebra to D0[1/t], with D0 viewed as a C0-algebra through cmod. No prime, annihilator, or Noetherian assumption is made.

source.place: Stacks Project, Tag 07CP (lemma-lifting), https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/07CP; read from the online tag because the local TeX is absent.

proof.text: Construct the canonical C0-algebra map from the coefficient localization and explicit auxiliary quotient variables. Its injectivity is the remaining conormal coefficient-comparison lemma; its surjectivity is proved from the k-th defining relations by polynomial induction and localization fractions. Combine these two properties using AlgEquiv.ofBijective.

theorem popescu_special_chart_polynomial (R : Type a) (Cbar : Type c)
    [CommRing R] [CommRing Cbar] [Algebra R Cbar] (π : R)
    [Algebra (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({π ^ 2} : Set R)) Cbar]
    [IsScalarTower R (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({π ^ 2} : Set R)) Cbar]
    (d : PopescuLiftPresentation R Cbar π) (hd : d.Prepared)
    (c : Cbar →ₐ[R] (d.liftingAlgebra ⧸
      Ideal.span ({algebraMap R d.liftingAlgebra π} : Set d.liftingAlgebra)))
    (cmod : (Cbar ⧸ Ideal.span ({algebraMap R Cbar π} : Set Cbar)) →+*
      (d.liftingAlgebra ⧸
        Ideal.span ({algebraMap R d.liftingAlgebra π} : Set d.liftingAlgebra)))
    (hc : ∀ i : Fin d.n, c (d.ε (MvPolynomial.X i)) = Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (d.x i))
    (hcmod : cmod.comp (Ideal.Quotient.mk _) = c.toRingHom)
    (k : Fin d.r) :
    let C₀ := Cbar ⧸ Ideal.span ({algebraMap R Cbar π} : Set Cbar)
    letI := cmod.toAlgebra
    Nonempty (MvPolynomial (d.E k)
      (Localization.Away (Ideal.Quotient.mk
        (Ideal.span ({algebraMap R Cbar π} : Set Cbar)) (d.ε (d.reduced (d.a k))))) ≃ₐ[C₀]
      Localization.Away (c (d.ε (d.reduced (d.a k)))))
